tha-ap11:1.1: bhāgīrathī → bhāgīrasī (sya-all) | bhāgīrathī → bhāgirasī (bj: machasaṁ, PTS, sī.selu)
tha-ap11:1.4: orime → orimaṁ (sya-all) | tariṁ → tare (sya-all) | tariṁ → orimaṁ ca tare (cck: syā.)
tha-ap11:2.2: dvipaduttamo vasī satasahassehi gaṅgātīramupāgato → dipaduttamo vīsasatasahassehi gaṅgāsotaṁ tarissati (sya-all) | padumuttaranāyako → padumuttaranāyako sambuddho dipaduttemo (bj: machasaṁ, PTS, aṭṭhakathā)
tha-ap11:2.4: tarissati → gaṅgātīramupāgato (bj: machasaṁ, the) | gaṅgātīramupāgato → pubbe mayhaṁ sutaṁ āsi,§‘‘padumuttaranāyako; vasīsatasahassehi, gaṅgāsotaṁ tarissati‘‘; (cck: sī.)
tha-ap11:4.2: ārūhi → āruhi (bj) | nāvakaṁ → nāvukaṁ (bj) | ārūhi tañca nāvakaṁ → āruyhi nāvalañjakaṁ (sya-all) | nāvukaṁ → nāvālañchakaṁ (bj: PTS, sī.selu, the, aṭṭhakathā)
tha-ap11:7.2: tārako → tāraṇo (sya-all) | tārako → tāraṇo (bj: the, sī.selu, aṭṭhakathā) | tārako → tāraṇo (cck: syā.)
tha-ap11:8.2: cammako → cambako (sya-all) | cammako → campako (cck: sī.); cambako (cck: syā.)
tha-ap11:12.4: nibbāyissatināsavo vīriyaṁ → nibbāyissatanāsavo viriyaṁ (bj); nibbāyissatyanāsavo viriyaṁ (sya-all)
tha-ap11:14.4: mama → imā dve gāthā PTS, sī.selu potthakesu na vijjanti (bj note)
tha-ap11:15.3: vanavāsibhikkhūnaggaṁ → vanavāsībhikkhūnaggaṁ (bj) | vanavāsībhikkhūnaggaṁ → jhāyīnaṁ bhikkhunaṁ (bj: the)
tha-ap11:15.4: mahāmati → imā dve gāthā PTS, sī.selu potthakesu na vijjanti (bj note)
